description: A quarterly board deck of an invented freight company, built as a PowerPoint file with python-pptx: 16:9 slides with text boxes, bullet lists, two tables, a native clustered column chart, and a footer text box plus a slide number field on every slide. Calibri is substituted by Carlito. The PDFs were rendered by LibreOffice 24.2 from the Office files (headless --convert-to pdf), not by Microsoft Office. The README lists slide decks (PPTX via PDF export) under the roadmap, so this case tests a producer and document type it does not claim. Edits: on the KPI slide the EBITDA margin lowered and free cash flow changed from negative to positive; in the chart the Q3 bar for Benelux raised from 11.2 to 12.6 (the axis is fixed at 0 to 20, so no other bar moves, and the chart has no data labels); a new slide "Cyber incident update" inserted after the cash slide; one risk bullet reworded; the treasury policy bullet moved from "Decisions requested" to "Items for noting"; and the meeting date in the footer changed on every slide. Consequences that are not listed: the slide numbers from slide 6 on (field), and all later slides shifting by one page.
